'''Tenina Sha-Dand''' was a [[Tarsunt]] member of the [[Jedi Order]]. During the [[High Republic Era]] in [[132 BBY]], she was still a [[youngling]] and attended a class led by [[Jedi Master]] [[Sol]] in the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]. Sol had the students close their [[eye]]s and [[Meditation|meditate]] while connecting with [[the Force]]. After several other students told Sol what they felt, Sol dismissed Sha-Dand and the other students for [[Foodstuff|lunch]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Connect to the Force. Have faith. Think of diving into a great ocean. Give yourselves over to its weight, its stillness, its uncertainty. And tell me what comes into your mind.|Sol instructs Sha-Dand and her class|audio=Sol-ConnectToTheForce-LostFound.flac|<ref name="LostFound" />}}
[[File:XilawaDater-LostFound.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Xilawa Dater, wearing tan Jedi robes, sits with her eyes closed among several other students, including Tenina Sha-Dand, on the floor of a training veranda in the Coruscant Jedi Temple. Behind them, the green-skinned Vernestra Rwoh stands in gold and yellow temple robes.|Tenina Sha-Dand was a Jedi youngling on Coruscant during the High Republic Era.]]
Tenina Sha-Dand was a [[Tarsunt]] who became a member of the [[Jedi Order]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. As a [[youngling]], Sha-Dand produced sculptures during [[meditation]] as manifestations of her youthful energy.<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> In [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> she and a class of other students were taught by [[Jedi Master]] [[Sol]] on one of the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]]'s training verandas on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]. Sha-Dand sat near the back of the class<ref name="LostFound" /> in a cross-[[Limb|legged]] meditation pose<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> and closed her [[eye]]s when Sol instructed the class to do so.<ref name="LostFound" />

The Jedi Master explained that the students' eyes could not be trusted, as they could be deceived, and so instead had them connect to [[the Force]]. When he then asked the students to tell him what they felt, Sha-Dand's classmates<ref name="LostFound" /> [[Khari Sendo]], [[Xilawa Dater]], and [[Jev Eremia]]<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> all responded with their differing interpretations of the Force. In response to Eremia's interpretation of seeing the Force as [[fire]], Sol explained that the Force was powerful like a fire or an [[ocean]] and so must be respected. Seeing that Jedi Master [[Vernestra Rwoh]] was waiting to speak to him, Sol then dismissed the class for [[Foodstuff|lunch]]. Sha-Dand opened her eyes and stood, bowing to Rwoh before leading the class off the veranda while shepherded by<ref name="LostFound" /> [[Jedi Knight]] [[Flurri Wiss]]<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> and another [[Jedi]].<ref name="LostFound" /> Sha-Dand partly shared her surname<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> with Tarsunt [[Resistance]] members [[Vober Dand]] and [[Ibdun Dand]].<ref name="TROSVD">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Tenina Sha-Dand was a shy individual, but this was bypassed by her youthful energy, which manifested in her sculptural works.<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> She had [[Color|black]] eyes, gray skin, and brown [[hair]].<ref name="LostFound" />

==Equipment==
During her lesson with Sol, Sha-Dand wore tan [[Jedi apparel|Jedi robes]] with a brown [[belt]] and brown shoes.<ref name="LostFound" /> The belt's gray buckle bore a seal of the late High Republic.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|According to The Visual Guide, her name is Tenina Sha-Dand. I hope that means she's an ancestor of Vober Dand, the original Tarsunt ground crew I designed for The Force Awakens.|Jake Lunt Davies|<ref name="JakeLuntDavies-Instagram">{{Instagram|username=jakeluntdavies|url=p/DQmtD0XjV_n|name=[[Jake Lunt Davies]]|date=2025-11-03|quote=Tarsunt Jedi Youngling concept for The Acolyte. According to The Visual Guide, her name is Tenina Sha-Dand. I hope that means she’s an ancestor of Vober Dand, the original Tarsunt ground crew I designed for The Force Awakens. ➡️ for Vober Dand concept and pics plus a few other Tarsunts from other shows #starwars #theacolyte #conceptdesign #creatureconcept #jedi #jediyounglings #lightsaber #conceptsketch #theforcewakens #forceawakens|archivefile=File:JakeLuntDavies-TeninaSha-Dand-Instagram.png}}</ref>}}
[[File:JakeLuntDavies-JediYounglings-ArtOfTheAcolyte.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Concept art of two different designs for Tenina Sha-Dand, both in tan Jedi robes. One with lighter skin has a lightsaber ignited and held up infront of her face, while the other holds an unignited lightsaber at her side.|Jake Lunt Davies created concept art of Tenina Sha-Dand.]]
Tenina Sha-Dand appeared in "[[Lost / Found]],"<ref name="LostFound" /> the first episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired on [[Disney+]] on [[June 4]], [[2024]].<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> Prior to the release of the episode, she was revealed in a trailer exclusively shown at [[Celebration Europe (2023)|Celebration Europe]]<ref name="Celebration">{{CelebrationTrailer|''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]''|Celebration Europe (2023)}}</ref> during the [[Lucasfilm]] Studio Showcase on [[April 7]], [[2023]].<ref name="CelebrationDate">{{SW|url=news/swce-2023-lucasfilm-studio-showcase|text=SWCE 2023: 11 Highlights from Lucasfilm's Studio Showcase}}</ref>

Concept artist [[Jake Lunt Davies]] created concept art in [[August]], [[2022]], showing two different designs for a Tarsunt Jedi youngling to appear in the show.<ref name="Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Acolyte]]''</ref> Davies also created a version of the art depicting both versions of Sha-Dand in a gray training [[helmet]].<ref name="JakeLuntDavies-Instagram" /> The scenes in the Jedi Temple were shot at [[Shinfield Studios]],<ref name="Fantha Part I">{{WebCite|url=https://www.fanthatracks.com/news/the-acolyte-a-journey-to-the-filming-locations-part-1-madeira|text=The Acolyte: A journey to the filming locations Part 1: Madeira|archivedate=20241204220147}}</ref> [[Wikipedia:England|England]].<ref name="Julian Foddy">{{Lucasfilm|url=news/julian-foddy-acolyte|text=''The Acolyte'' Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Foddy}}</ref>

The character was first named in the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> After learning of the name, Davies stated that he hoped that this meant Tenina Sha-Dand was an ancestor of Vober Dand, the first Tarsunt character, who Davies had designed for<ref name="JakeLuntDavies-Instagram" /> the [[2015]] [[sequel trilogy]] film<ref name="VII">{{Film|VII}}</ref> [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']].<ref name="JakeLuntDavies-Instagram" />
